# ourapps.app

> Delivering Our Applications, built from Our Recipes, using Our Agentically-Engineered Components. Our apps for our businesses, our club, our home, our shop: for a small business, a club or society, a household, a shop or practice. A public recipe library and component catalogue, and private share links that deliver the finished applications. Developers sign in with GitHub, publish recipes and components, register apps and create share links. Install paths cover iPhone and iPad through TestFlight, Android packages, Mac disk images, Windows installers, matching ready Mac and Apple TV TestFlight invitations, and web apps.

- [API reference for agents](https://ourapps.app/agents.md): every endpoint, auth with `Authorization: Bearer oa_...`, workflows.
- [Technical reference](https://ourapps.app/reference): supported app types, where every part runs, web app hosting on the developer's own Cloudflare account, engines and frameworks.
- [Free services for small organisations' apps](https://ourapps.app/free-tiers.md): video, realtime, databases, AI and more on free plans, with agent setup steps.
- [Building on GitHub with no machine of your own](https://ourapps.app/cloud-assembly.md): aepm in GitHub Actions from a committed `answers.json` (workflow https://ourapps.app/aepm-assemble.yml), then the recipe's check, release and update workflows, and the secrets they need.
- [Repository contract](https://ourapps.app/contract.md): what an app's GitHub repository must publish and the calls its workflow makes.
- Target selection: six default-enabled switches (`ios`, `android`, `web`, `macos`, `windows`, `tvos`). Owners save one through `PUT /api/dev/apps/:id/targets/:target` with exactly `{enabled:boolean}`; workflows read `{targets:{six booleans}}` through `GET /api/build/:app/targets` with the app build token. Disabled targets leave shared install/update options and block new target work with 409 `Target is disabled.`; setup, artifacts and uploaded-build processing remain. Re-enable sends no build; normal scheduled expiry renewal resumes. Issued capabilities and existing Apple/hosted addresses remain usable. Exact scope and workflow rules: agents.md and contract.md.
- What a download is: a component package is the source code itself (one `.tar` archive: the implementation per device or server, its contract, tests and a manifest listing every file), not a link to code. A recipe package is `recipe.json` (questions, slots, settings) plus the recipe's own application code, artwork and text; the components that fill its slots are separate downloads. Archives are release files on the publisher's public GitHub repository; ourapps keeps a pointer and the sha256 digest, never the code. aepm checks the digest and runs none of the package's code when installing.
- Recipe library: https://ourapps.app/recipes (plain text: /recipes.txt, JSON: /api/recipes). Search: `/api/recipes/search?q=`. A recipe's build steps, questions (with `askWhen` and the settings each answer sets), slots (each with `includedWhen`), jobs and components: `/recipes/<name>.txt`; its description, slot classes, suitability, guardians, connections, tested answers and package foundations: `/recipes/<name>/details.txt`. Build from one with aepm (https://github.com/ourapps-ae/aepm): `aepm fetch <recipe>@<version> --with-dependencies`, `aepm questions`, `aepm design`, `aepm resolve`, `aepm install`; the steps are on each recipe's .txt page and in /agents.md. One-command assembly (`aepm create`) is coming soon. Its bundle link is `/api/recipes/<name>/<version>/bundle`.
- Component catalogue: https://ourapps.app/components (plain text: /components.txt, JSON: /api/components). Filter by `provides=`, `requires=`, `category=`, `target=`, `tag=`, `deprecated=exclude|include|only`; search `/api/components/search?q=`. A component's class, interfaces, platforms, toolchains, settings and the recipe slot that names it: `/components/<name>.txt`; its upstream sources, exact dependencies and file lists: `/components/<name>/details.txt`.
- Slots: `class` is exactly `{name,version,digest}`, resolved from independent inline declarations in the recipe package's `classes`. Each descriptor owns interfaces, platform modules, settings and shared behaviour suites with file/digest inventories. A candidate lists the exact reference in `implements`, carries the same descriptor, satisfies ports/settings/modules and has compatible platforms, runtimes, frameworks, dependency pins and styles. `aepm alternatives <recipe>@<version> <slot> --store store` lists fitting implementations; `aepm design ... --substitute <slot>=<name>@<version>` selects one.
- Publication requires `foundations:{licence,platforms,classes,implements,upstream,compatibility,maintenance,files,artefacts}` from the validated canonical package manifest. Wrapper and upstream licences remain distinct; upstream delivery states bundled source or an exact build-time dependency with its npm, Gradle or Swift lock. Public facts are publisher-declared (`foundationEvidence` is `publisher-declared`); a version gives a `foundations` summary with counts, and `/api/{recipes,components}/<name>/<version>/details` the full lists. The Worker checks descriptor hashes and declared structure; aepm checks archive bytes, selected answers and signed review evidence. Field mapping: /contract.md, Package foundations.
- Deprecated and orphaned entries: every recipe and component response, page and `.txt` carries a `deprecations` array (and a `DEPRECATION WARNING:` line in text) for the entry and the components it uses. A recipe's full tree: `/api/recipes/<name>/<version>/deprecations`. Search for replacements or similar recipes, or decide never to update. An orphaned entry's publisher deleted their account; its bundle link says `bundle-unavailable` unless the release is public.
- Sitemap: https://ourapps.app/sitemap.xml
- Console: https://ourapps.app/dev (sign in with GitHub). API keys and agent prompts: https://ourapps.app/dev/agents.
- Source: https://github.com/ourapps-ae/ourapps
